# ECN-2026-020 - Change notice - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2
Revision: Rev B
Plant: P2, line P2-L4
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-HT02

Reason for change
- Update to calibration control and maintenance traceability for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 after audit findings identified inconsistent thermocouple records and gaps in process documentation. The thermocouple calibration interval for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 55 days. This ECN aligns maintenance practice with SOP requirements and closes nonconformances referenced during the audit.

Affected items
- EQ-P2-L4-HT02 thermocouple assemblies and associated calibration records.
- Work instruction references in SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-02 where interval and recordkeeping language are established.
- Maintenance master file entry MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 to reflect the revised calibration interval and required record fields.

Implementation
- Update MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2 to record the thermocouple calibration interval change and include a field for calibration method and verifier initials.
- Revise SOP-P2-L4-01 and SOP-P2-L4-02 sections that reference thermocouple calibration to reflect the interval and to require an auditable entry in the equipment log.
- Communicate the change to the Heat Treat maintenance team and operations with a focused briefing covering why the interval change was made and how to complete records moving forward.
- Apply the revised calibration interval to all active thermocouples on EQ-P2-L4-HT02 and ensure documentation is completed in the equipment log associated with MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2.
- Retain original calibration certificates in the equipment file and attach updated entries per SOP procedures.

Approvals
- Prepared by: Maintenance Engineering
- Reviewed against: MM-P2-L4-HT02-S2, SOP-P2-L4-01, SOP-P2-L4-02
- Approval required from Maintenance Manager and Plant Quality representative prior to implementation.
